_doc: MSRP per product type, verified values only. Lookup order: sets[groupId][type] -> eras[era][type] -> defaults[type]; each currency resolves independently; null = unknown, and ROI@MSRP is not shown. Add a value only with a primary source (an official Pokémon / Pokémon Center list price you can link to), e.g. { "USD": { "value": 49.99, "effectiveDate": "YYYY-MM-DD", "confidence": "list", "source": "https://..." } }. The UI hides the MSRP columns while no product has an MSRP.
_removed: 2026-10-28: all previous values were removed. The Pokémon Company publishes no US MSRPs; pokemoncenter.com could not be read to verify list prices; and the third-party trackers disagreed (ETB $49.99 vs $59.99, booster bundle $25.00 vs $26.94). Canadian values were relayed second-hand, one was estimated and one derived.
